title: Hexen
subtitle: Raven, 1995 · 70,000 lines — compiles and runs; its retail WAD has no SKY1 (see ROADMAP P6.2)
safepointsNote: These games get their TIME from an interrupt and wait for it inside a loop of their own C -- Heretic's TryRunTics spins on `ticcount`, which only the ISR writes. A safepoint is the only place this runtime can reach into such a loop, so without them the game waits for ever and looks exactly like a hang.
_needsData: `dir` is the data ROOT this program's files live under -- a directory served by `serve.mjs --games=<dir>`, named after it. The shell fetches that one when the program starts, and no other: a program's data is not the shelf's data.
